title: Life Plan Benefits Bulletin: Returned-Payment Courtesy for Life Plan Households on Respite Stays
content:
Life Plan households holding a Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement receive a courtesy on the returned-payment fee of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

**Benefit.** The Life Plan courtesy is twenty-five percent (25 percent) for a guest holding an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare plan, ten percent (10 percent) for one on a fee-for-service plan, and nothing otherwise.

**What it reduces.** The courtesy is taken on the statutory service charge of the returned payment as it stands, and on nothing else in the fee: the service charge is multiplied by 75 percent at 25 percent and by 90 percent at 10 percent.

**Records read.** The guest's Entrance Fee Agreement, whether it is in occupied status, and the contract type of its plan — lifecare for the LifeCare Declining Balance Plan and the LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan, fee-for-service for the LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% and 90% Refundable Plans.

| Entrance Fee Agreement | Contract type | Life Plan courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Occupied | Lifecare | 25 percent |
| Occupied | Fee-for-service | 10 percent |
| Reserved, terminated, refund scheduled, closed, rescinded, cancelled, or none held | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations (service charge of 30.00 as it stands)

- Occupied LifeCare agreement: 30.00 times 75 percent, that is 22.50.
- Occupied LifeChoice agreement: 30.00 times 90 percent, that is 27.00.
- A reserved agreement, not yet occupied: 30.00, no courtesy.
